Get the current weather in Tokyo, Japan right now: temperature, conditions, humidity, wind. Report the observation time and source URL.

# Current Weather — Tokyo, Japan

**Primary source (live API):** https://wttr.in/Tokyo?format=j1

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Temperature** | 28 °C (82 °F) |
| **Feels like** | 33 °C (91 °F) |
| **Conditions** | Overcast (100% cloud cover) |
| **Humidity** | 84% |
| **Wind** | 18 km/h (11 mph) from SW (226°) |
| **Observation time** | 04:40 AM (local, per API `current_condition`) |
| **Pressure / Visibility** | 1010 mb / 10 km |

## Important caveats

1. **Location mismatch:** The wttr.in response resolved the query to **Shikinejima, Tokyo region** (lat 34.327, lon 139.218) — an island ~150 km south of central Tokyo — not the Tokyo metropolitan area. So this reading may not represent downtown Tokyo conditions.
2. **Timestamp ambiguity:** The API reported "04:40 AM" without an explicit date/timezone in the extracted report. The host observation time was ~1789923428 s (Unix), but I could not confirm the observation's own date.
3. **Cross-source disagreement:** A parallel search returned conflicting readings from other sites (AccuWeather: 78 °F, 74% humidity, ENE 1 mph, mostly cloudy; Exa: 71 °F, 96%, NNW 4 mph, dense drizzle; weathercity: 23 °C, 94.1%, N 31 km/h). These lack consistent timestamps and disagree substantially, so they cannot corroborate a single "right now" value.

**Bottom line:** The most complete single live reading is **28 °C, overcast, 84% humidity, SW wind 18 km/h**, observed 04:40 AM local per wttr.in — but treat it as approximate given the island-location resolution and the conflicting third-party figures. For a definitive metropolitan Tokyo reading, a source with an explicit station and timestamp (e.g., Japan Meteorological Agency) would be preferable.
